evidence_status: Fourth-pass QEMU 11.1.2 execution observations cover all 853 fixtures; 833 matched checked outcomes, 20 disagreements/omissions; individual profile/assertion limitations apply. Actual M1 Max capability measured. No Sail execution or exhaustive proof.

source_versions.arm_renderings: Primarily 2026-03_rel; older cached pages explicitly distinguished. Raw Arm-authored 2025-03 XML now retrieved from the pinned mirror and linked per catalogue entry.

arm_raw_xml.origin: Arm-authored XML retrieved from a public third-party mirror; not downloaded from Arm directly.
arm_raw_xml.coverage: All 98 original catalogue forms plus 27 added forms. 92 baseline masks exact; six aliases checked as specializations and against MSR CRm decoding.
arm_raw_xml.comparison: 125 XML catalogue entries; 123 have pinned Sail execution functions, two FP8 forms absent.

qemu.scope: Static reading of decoder patterns, FP8 helpers, translation gates. No QEMU execution.

arm_errata.scope: Reserved FPMR F8S1/F8S2 input formats permit a constrained choice, superseding a universal sNaN claim.

scope: Requested SME/SME2 and expanded predicate scope, extended with all 8 SME2p1 vector-group ZERO forms, 15 MOVAZ forms, 2 strided LUTI2 forms, and 2 FP8 FMOPA forms listed in notes. Other predicate operations remain decode/legality-only.

defaults.features: Required catalogue feature(s) present unless explicitly overridden; features_absent wins. For normal vectors SM=1 uses streaming SVE.
defaults.access_controls: Permit all relevant accesses unless explicitly overridden.
defaults.memory: Normal, mapped, no tag or address faults unless explicitly unmapped.
defaults.registers: Unspecified inputs zero; current-width registers only.

fixture_contract.instruction_word: 32-bit numeric hex; little-endian byte order when serialized.
fixture_contract.register_keys: Direct Xn/Wn/Zn/Pn keys and entries under registers are equivalent. PNn aliases Pn storage.
fixture_contract.values: Hexadecimal strings are exact bit patterns, zero-extended to the target width. Scalar decimal strings are exact integers.
fixture_contract.vector_data: fill_element repeats the bit pattern at decoded esize (source_element_size for widening). fill_byte repeats a byte. elements and repeat_elements list low-to-high lanes; repeat_elements cycles to VL. Per-register element_overrides maps zero-based element indices to exact bit patterns and is applied after any fill/repetition.
fixture_contract.predicates: Pn_active_elements lists zero-based source element indices; all means every source element active; [] means none. Set only bit e*(source_esize/8).
fixture_contract.table: ZT0_u32_slots lists sixteen low-to-high 32-bit slots. two_bit_indices packs the first entry into bits1:0.
fixture_contract.matrix: ZA_fill_byte initializes backing bytes. ZA_tile initializes a logical interleaved tile. ZA_slice_initial/ZA_slices_initial/ZA_rows_initial override it. Tile(t,E)[r,c] aliases backing byte row t+r*(E/8), columns c*(E/8)..(c+1)*(E/8)-1.
fixture_contract.matrix_outputs: ZA_tile_result and ZA_slice_result replace the complete named view; ZA_cell_patches/ZA_slice_patch/ZA_slice_patches/ZA_row_patches alter only named cells/lanes/rows. Unnamed backing bytes preserved.
fixture_contract.memory: base is an exact byte address. count elements of element_size bits initialized with fill_element. mapped=false forbids accesses. memory_patch writes only the listed element indices at base+e*(esize/8).
fixture_contract.preservation: All unspecified output architectural storage preserved apart from PC advance; upper bits beyond current VL are not asserted. Explicit reset cases cover full storage. ARBITRARY is unconstrained.
fixture_contract.exceptions: outcome and sme_exception_type assert classification and no normal destination write. Complete exception-entry register effects/syndrome routing are intentionally not asserted. The general preservation default applies to normal completion only. On faults, only explicit expected assertions constrain state; exception entry is excluded. state_transition_performed=false means no instruction-driven SM/ZA reset, not a claim about exception-entry PSTATE.
fixture_contract.encoding_fields: Fields include fixed decode parameters such as size/S/Q. fixed_mask and fixed_value are relative to the field, not the whole word. Never overwrite fixed bits while constructing an encoding.
fixture_contract.feature_override: features_present/absent override default feature presence; feature_any_of is a disjunction. Architectural implication of an implemented extension must still hold. Gate fixtures explicitly model SME-only streaming support. FEAT_ prefixes are optional in legacy case inputs and are normalized before comparison. Explicit presence adds to required constructor features; absence takes priority and must not leave an impossible architectural feature combination.
fixture_contract.extended: Per-Z esize/element_size overrides decoded width. ZA_rows_initial/ZA_row_patches contain row and fill_byte; ZA_slices_initial and ZA_slice_patches contain tile, esize, orientation and slice. FPMR_fields assigns architectural bitfields by name. EnFPM controls SCTLR_EL1.EnFPM in the EL0, non-host, no-EL2/no-EL3 fixtures. features_absent names use FEAT_ prefixes.
fixture_contract.abstract_memory_faults: first_access_fault injects a synchronous fault at the first active Mem access, without earlier faults. It is a memory-provider contract, not a supplied page-table image. Such vectors assert no complete exception-entry state. SPAlignmentFault fixtures use SA0=1, SP not 16-byte aligned and an active predicate.
fixture_contract.profile: Arm XML 2025-03 with explicit later clarifications is authoritative; Arm erratum R22907 supersedes the XML helper's deterministic treatment of reserved FPMR formats. Older Sail reset differences remain qualified. QEMU is an independent source-level corroborator, never an executed oracle in this package.

counter_representation.type: lowest set bit t of raw[3:0]; zero nibble means empty
counter_representation.count_bits: raw[k:t+1], k=log2(4*PL), PL=VL/8, for the power-of-two current vector lengths used here.
counter_representation.expansion: For 0<=e<4*VL/(8*2^t), expanded bit e*2^t = (e<count) XOR raw[15]; other bits zero.
counter_representation.ignored_bits: raw bits above k except bit15; source P bits above15
counter_representation.length_profile: All supplied counter fixtures use power-of-two VL. Pinned Sail uses HighestSetBit(CeilPow2(4*PL)); do not extrapolate this digest's shorthand to non-power-of-two non-streaming lengths without selecting the applicable architecture profile.

third_pass_changes.previous_passes: Preserved unchanged under first-pass/ and second-pass/. Third-pass vectors supersede matching previous fixtures.
